name: Sonnet contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Rotate into confirmed sector breakouts/breakdowns (financials, healthcare, biotech momentum, gold-miner and semi-extreme mean reversion) plus a defensive low-vol/utilities vs discretionary relative-value pair, rather than betting on beaten-down single names or fading crowded fear trades.
novelty: Round 1 bet on idiosyncratic turnaround catalysts in depressed single names; Round 2 faded AI-disruption fear and oversold crypto. Round 3's edge is sector-level relative value and trend-confirmation: ride already-confirmed rotations (XLF/KRE credit-cycle strength, XLV/XBI healthcare-biotech breakout) while shorting extended/breaking-down groups (GDX gold miners rolling over, SOXL semis post-parabolic crack) and running a defensive pair (long low-vol/utilities vs short discretionary) — a trend-and-carry sector rotation book, not a single-name catalyst or fear-fade book.

positions.thesis: Regional banks confirmed uptrend (+5.5%/1m, +10.2%/3m, +14.5%/6m) riding credit-cycle/rate-curve tailwind; momentum plus carry from steepening curve.
Healthcare showing fresh acceleration (+4.0%/1m) after a weak 6m, a defensive sector re-rating early in its rotation.
Biotech in a confirmed strong breakout (+14.6%/1m, +82.7%/12m) — momentum continuation into H2 catalysts (approvals, M&A).
Low-volatility defensive tilt as ballast against a stretched Nasdaq/semis complex heading into H2 volatility.
Utilities offer bond-proxy carry and AI-power-demand tailwind while discretionary weakens — relative value long leg.
Gold miners in a sharp confirmed breakdown (-13.2%/1m, -24.3%/3m) as gold itself rolls over (-6.1%/1m, -15.5%/3m); trend continuation short.
3x semis after a +506% 12m parabolic move just cracked -39.2% in a month — leveraged mean-reversion short on an extended, now-breaking trend.
Consumer discretionary is the weakest S&P sector on 3m/6m (-0.8%/-3.9%) — relative-value short leg vs the XLU long, pure sector pair carry/rotation.

outlook: Expect continued sector dispersion into year-end: financials and healthcare/biotech extend confirmed uptrends on credit-cycle and re-rating tailwinds, while gold/miners and the most extended semis names mean-revert after historic 12m moves. A defensive utilities-over-discretionary pair and ample cash (22%, earning 4% APY) provide ballast against a stretched broad market (SPY +22.7%/12m) without relying on single-name catalysts or fading crowded fear trades.
